_comment: Absolute bounds for the backfill lane. These hold REGARDLESS of what any spec claims - an inherited number disarms every gate built around it, so these are the bounds that do not inherit. Widening any value is a HUMAN act: edit the per-run copy in the run's artifacts dir (backfill-limits.json there) before the census node runs, or edit this file for a durable change. preflight copies this file into the artifacts dir; every gate reads the per-run copy.
